messages:
acme_ops: Hey @jamie we started seeing parse_error on our ingestion after switching to json_mode=streaming. Our downstream JSON parser crashes because some required fields are null or there are unexpected extra keys. This began after yesterday's rollout. Example below.

jamie_support: Sorry for the trouble — can you paste the exact request and a sample response (raw stream) so we can triage? Also you mentioned a billing spike — can you confirm account id?

acme_ops: Sample response we received from the stream (assembled naively):
```json
{"items":[{"id":"123","price":null},{"id":"124","price":19.99,"extra_info":"x"},{"id":"125","price":29.99}]}
```
But the actual bytes we got were split across chunks and contained a mid-object split that made our parser fail, e.g. chunk boundaries ended up like: `...\n","price":\n` then next chunk started `null},{\"id\":\"124\"...`
We also saw a cost spike in the last 24h on account 9876.

liz_eng: Tagging eng to investigate. @mario_sre any abnormal metrics (latency, dropped connections) on streaming nodes?

mario_sre: No node OOMs or throttles showing. We rolled a kernel/IO patch last night that slightly changed flush timing for streaming outputs. Could be related to how we flush token deltas.

liz_eng: Hypothesis: streaming delta emission can split nested JSON structures at chunk boundaries; some clients expect only top-level object boundaries and crash on mid-object splits. Need raw bytes to repro. @acme_ops can you paste the raw chunk dump (including chunk separators)?

acme_ops: Raw dump attached (simplified):
--chunk1--
{"items":[{"id":"123","price":
--chunk2--
null},{"id":"124","price":19.99,"extra_info":"x"},
--chunk3--
{"id":"125","price":29.99}]}
Notice chunk2 starts mid-value which turns the assembled stream into invalid JSON if the client attempts to parse per-chunk.

jamie_support: OK. Proposed plan: 1) Eng to validate streaming framing and avoid splitting inside JSON atomic tokens; 2) SRE to check deploy impact; 3) Billing to review retries and refund/credit if applicable; 4) Provide customer workaround advice.

sam_billing: Confirmed account 9876 had a 3x usage increase yesterday. It looks like client retries after parse failures caused the spike. I'll hold off auto-invoicing alerts and will review credits once we know retry counts.

liz_eng: Note from eng: current streaming implementation emits token deltas which are not guaranteed to contain full nested-object atomicity for deep arrays. We documented top-level chunk guarantees but not nested-array safety — that was an oversight. Short-term mitigations: recommend disabling streaming or switching to newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) where each object is complete per line. Long-term: we should change emitter to prefer chunk boundaries at JSON-safe locations.

mario_sre: I reproduced this locally by forcing a long array and hitting a tokenization boundary at 512 tokens. The emitter split inside an object. I'll open a patch to avoid splitting inside string/value tokens and to emit an explicit boundary marker when necessary.

acme_ops: Disabling streaming fixed the parse errors for us but increased end-to-end latency and cost. We need an ETA on a proper fix.

liz_eng: Short-term guidance: if immediate parsing required, set json_mode to newline_delimited (one full object per line) or buffer client-side until you see a closing ']' before parsing. We'll push a patch to ensure safer boundaries and add a 'chunk_boundary' sentinel in the stream to help reassembly. ETA: patch in next 24 hours, deploy tomorrow.

jamie_support: We'll open a support ticket for billing credits for the retry storm. @sam_billing can you take ownership? Also we'll schedule a brief postmortem and update streaming docs.

sam_billing: Taking ownership. Please send retry counts and request IDs/timestamps; I'll draft a credit proposal.

acme_ops: Thanks — we'll share retry logs and raw headers. Appreciate the quick attention. :thumbsup:

liz_eng: Action items summarized: ENG (liz_eng) to push framing patch and add boundary marker; SRE (mario_sre) to validate deploy and monitor; Support (jamie_support) to coordinate customer communication and interim workaround; Billing (sam_billing) to evaluate credits. We'll update this thread with PR/CL and deploy status.

jamie_support: Thanks everyone — assigning owners and following up.
